Bug ID · Title: BUG-001 · Bottom links do nothing (Contact Us, Privacy, Support, etc.)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Scroll to bottom. 3. Click Contact Us, Privacy, Support Home, Community, View Plans.
Expected Behavior: Each link should open its page, like in real Docusign.
Actual Behavior: Clicking those buttons/links produce no response and no link is opened.
Notes / Hypothesis: Links are not connected, may be all has # values.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-002 · Add Recipients: Contact icon does nothing in Name field
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Under Add Recipients. 4. Click the contact icon inside the Name field.
Expected Behavior: Clicking the contact icon should open the contact search/selection option, consistent with the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: Clicking the contact icon produces no visible response and no contact search/selection option is displayed.
Notes / Hypothesis: The contact-selection functionality associated with the icon may not be implemented or may not be triggering.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-003 · Add Recipients: Set signing order is enabled with one recipient
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Under Add Recipients. 4. Observe the Set signing order when only one recipient is present.
Expected Behavior: Set signing order should be disabled when only one recipient is present, as in the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: Set signing order is displayed as an enabled/selectable option even when only one recipient is present.
Notes / Hypothesis: The enabled state may not be updated based on the number of recipients.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-004 · Add Recipients: In Person Signer option is disabled
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Under Add Recipients. 4. Open the recipient type dropdown currently showing Needs to Sign. 5. Click In Person Signer.
Expected Behavior: In Person Signer should be available for selection. Selecting it should add Host Name and Host Email fields for the in-person signer workflow, consistent with the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: In Person Signer is displayed as disabled/greyed out in the recipient type dropdown. Clicking it does not select the option or display the Host Name and Host Email fields.
Notes / Hypothesis: The In Person Signer recipient type may not be implemented or may be incorrectly disabled.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-005 · Add Recipients: Recipient customization options are disabled
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Under Add Recipients. 4. Click Customize.
Expected Behavior: Recipient customization options such as Add access code, Add private message, and Advanced settings should be available, consistent with the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: Add access code, Add private message, and Advanced settings are displayed as greyed out and cannot be selected.
Notes / Hypothesis: Recipient customization options may be incorrectly disabled in the clone.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-006 · Add Recipients: Invalid email accepted and allows progression
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Upload a document. 4. In Add Recipients, enter a recipient name. 5. Enter an invalid email address (e.g., "aafd"). 6. Click Next: Add Fields.
Expected Behavior: The system should validate the recipient email address and prevent progression when an invalid email is entered, consistent with the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: The clone accepts the invalid email address and proceeds directly to the Add Fields screen without displaying an email validation error.
Notes / Hypothesis: Email format validation may be missing or may only be performed at a later stage.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-007 · Edit Recipients: Save button does not save changes
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Create an envelope and proceed to Add Fields. 3. Open Edit Recipients. 4. Modify any recipient information. 5. Click Save.
Expected Behavior: Clicking Save should save the modified recipient information and close the Edit Recipients dialog, consistent with the original DocuSign.
Actual Behavior: Clicking Save produces no response. The Edit Recipients dialog remains open and the changes are not saved.
Notes / Hypothesis: The Save action may not be triggering the recipient update operation.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-008 · Templates: Advanced Search missing owner and recipient filters

Actual Behavior: The clone's Advanced Search provides only Template name and Template ID. Owner name and email and Recipient name and email filters are unavailable.
Notes / Hypothesis: Advanced Search may have incomplete filter functionality in the clone.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-009 · Create Template: Save Changes dialog leaves required Template name empty
Module / Screen: Start → Envelope Templates → Create a Template
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Click Start 3. Under templates -> Envelope Templates. 4. Click Create Template. 5. Click the X/close icon to exit the template.
Expected Behavior: The Template name field should be prepopulated with a default template name, as in the original DocuSign, allowing the user to save the current progress without first entering a name.
Actual Behavior: The Template name field is empty and marked required. The Save button is disabled until the user manually enters a template name.
Notes / Hypothesis: Original DocuSign automatically generates a default template name in this dialog. Clone does not provide a default value.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-012 · Same email can be added twice and the file is sent
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. From Home, click Get Signatures. 3. Under Add Recipients. 4. Add two recipients with same email. 3. Click Next: Add Fields

Bug ID · Title: BUG-39 · Date filter options differ from original DocuSign
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Open agreements. 3. Click the Date filter. 4. Compare the date-filter options with original one.
Expected Behavior: The clone's Date filter should provide the same date-filter options and controls as the original DocuSign for the equivalent screen.
Actual Behavior: The clone's Date filter has different options from the original. The original provides Last 12 Months, Last 6 Months, Last 30 Days, Last 7 Days, and Last 24 Hours, along with a comparison/operator dropdown. The clone instead includes All time, Last 12 months, Last 6 months, Last 30 days, Last week, Last 24 hours, and Custom, and uses Reset instead of the original Cancel button.
Notes / Hypothesis: The clone's date-filter implementation does not match the corresponding original DocuSign filter. Verify whether the additional/different options are intentionally implemented before final submission.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-040 · Status filter options differ from original DocuSign
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Log in. 2. Open agreements. 3. Click the Status filter. 4. Compare the status-filter options with original one.
Expected Behavior: The clone's Status filter should provide the same status options and filter controls as the corresponding original DocuSign screen.
Actual Behavior: The Status filter differs between the two. The original provides Completed, Correcting, Declined, In progress, and Voided. The clone provides All, In progress, Completed, Declined, and Voided. The filter action also differs: the original has Cancel, while the clone has Reset.
Notes / Hypothesis: The Status filter implementation in the clone does not match the corresponding original filter. The clone includes an All option and omits Correcting.

Bug ID · Title: BUG-041 · Sender filter options differ from original DocuSign
